Maya C (Partnerships): Ok team — kicking off 3-way integration prep: Snowflake connector + Databricks notebooks + vector DB (Qdrant) marketplace listing. Goal: coordinated launch and HW-accel runtime support. thoughts?

James L (Product): Need timeline for marketplace certification. Partner PMs want a firm date by next Wed. Can we get a beta listing by then? :eyes:

Priya S (Eng): Working on connector adapter. Two blockers: per-account auth flow for Snowflake (key rotation) and Databricks token handling. I can unblock Snowflake by EOW, Databricks early next week.

Dan R (Eng-ML): I'll package the optimized runtime container with CUDA + cuBLAS patches for nv accel. ETA Tuesday. Will need a test matrix for sequence lengths and batch sizes.

Elena T (PMM): Announcement sync: marketing needs co-branded assets and joint quote from Snowflake/Databricks. Can ops/partner folks chase legal approvals? target announcement week of Apr 6.

Maya C (Partnerships): Assigning owners: Priya -> connector adapter & test harness; Dan -> accel container & perf bench; James -> marketplace listing + certification; Elena -> joint-announce assets. I'll coordinate partner approvals. Please add checklist items to this doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/3way-integration (internal).

Priya S (Eng): Added test checklist. Quick config snippet for internal QA env:
```env
CONNECTOR_SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT=acme_us
CONNECTOR_SNOWFLAKE_KEYNAME=redwood-integ
VECTOR_DB_HOST=qdrant.internal:6333
```
Will run nightly smoke tests.

Dan R (Eng-ML): Perf bench plan: batch sizes [1,4,8,16], seq lens [128,512,2048], measure p99/realtime. Dropping quantized variant for baseline.

James L (Product): Marketplace steps: cert checklist, screenshots, pricing SKU, docs link. Need final copy by Mon COB. I'll draft.

Elena T (PMM): :thumbsup: I'll prep assets and draft joint blog outline. Who's exposing metrics for the console screenshot? ops?

Maya C (Partnerships): Ops: @Amit K can you provide a prod-like console screenshot with token-level cost breakdown for demo by Mon?

Amit K (Eng-Infra): On it — I'll provision a sandbox and post screenshot here by Monday. Also enabling audit logs for the Private deployment demo.

release-bot: Smoke-run queued: 12 tests, 0 failures. Log: https://ci.redwood/1234

James L (Product): Quick question: are we using Snowflake External Functions or the connector approach? That affects auth flow.

Priya S (Eng): Connector approach. External functions were considered but not supported with vector DB latency requirements.

Dan R (Eng-ML): Also flagging HW partnership ask: need confirmation from NVIDIA on driver compatibility for our dedupe kernel. @Sasha P can you loop in the hardware partner manager?

Maya C (Partnerships): Yes — looping in Sasha (HW PM) and Snow/DB partner leads. I'll send intro email today.

Elena T (PMM): Ok — next sync Friday 10am PT. Agenda: cert blockers, perf results, assets signoff.

Everyone: :thumbsup:
